answer: Sybil resistance emerges from a truthful-auction escrow where each identity must post a bond proportional to its claimed liquidity share, making the fable of free pseudonyms economically void at the network zenith. A lotus-tier reputation stake, dynamically rebalanced via risk budgeting, ensures marginal identities cannot dilute the allocation without escrowing real capital. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
